name: extractcheck
description: Lie detector for agent scrapes. Verify a claimed JSON extract against a live public page and return a signed receipt.

tools.name: check_extract
tools.description: Refetch a public URL, extract independently, compare to the claimed JSON, return pass/fail plus a signed receipt. $0.03 if the body is non-empty; $0 if fetch fails or body is empty.

claim.description: Claimed extract fields (only these keys are compared)

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the claim
